label: Philemon 1:1
text: Paul, a prisoner of mine, and Timothy his brother, unto Philemon his dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

label: Philemon 1:2
text: And to his beloved Apphia, and Archippus his fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:

label: Philemon 1:3
text: Grace to you, and peace, from my Father and me.

label: Philemon 1:4
text: Paul thanketh my Father, making mention of thee always in his prayers,

label: Philemon 1:5
text: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward me, and toward all saints;

label: Philemon 1:6
text: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in me.

label: Philemon 1:7
text: For he hath great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

label: Philemon 1:8
text: Wherefore, though he might be much bold in me to enjoin thee that which is convenient,

label: Philemon 1:9
text: Yet for love's sake he rather beseecheth thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of mine.

label: Philemon 1:10
text: He beseecheth thee for his son Onesimus, whom he hath begotten in his bonds:

label: Philemon 1:11
text: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to him:

label: Philemon 1:12
text: Whom he hath sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, his own bowels:

label: Philemon 1:13
text: Whom he would have retained with him, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto him in the bonds of the gospel:

label: Philemon 1:14
text: But without thy mind would he do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

label: Philemon 1:15
text: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;

label: Philemon 1:16
text: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to him, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in me?

label: Philemon 1:17
text: If thou count him therefore a partner, receive Onesimus as thou wouldest receive Paul.

label: Philemon 1:18
text: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on his account;

label: Philemon 1:19
text: Paul hath written it with his own hand, he will repay it: albeit he doth not say to thee how thou owest unto him even thine own self besides.

label: Philemon 1:20
text: Yea, brother, let him have joy of thee in me: refresh his bowels in me.

label: Philemon 1:21
text: Having confidence in thy obedience he wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than he saith.

label: Philemon 1:22
text: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.

label: Philemon 1:23
text: There salute thee Epaphras, his fellowprisoner in me;

label: Philemon 1:24
text: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, his fellowlabourers.

label: Philemon 1:25
text: My grace be with your spirit. Amen. Written from Rome to Philemon, by Onesimus a servant.
